text: The Civic Appointments Committee will conduct interviews and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment to the Toronto Investment Board.

City Council on March 25 and 26, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint Lovisa McCallum to the Toronto Investment Board, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on March 28, 2030, and until a successor is appointed. 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to 4 to the report (February 18, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Investment Board. Confidential Attachments 1a, 1b, and 2 to 4 to the report (February 18, 2026) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006, as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Toronto Investment Board.
